concepts.learning_objective: Explain why major development choices must be political decisions taken or approved by the people's representatives.

Describe how development was equated with Western-style modernisation after Independence.
Distinguish the liberal-capitalist and socialist models of development available to India in 1947.
State what the terms Left and Right mean regarding the role of the state in the economy.
Describe how the Planning Commission was set up, its advisory role and its objectives.
Explain the significance of the Bombay Plan of 1944 drafted by big industrialists.
Identify the world experiences that built public support for planning in the 1940s and 1950s.

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how five year plans and the plan and non-plan budgets worked, and why a plan holiday was taken in 1966.
